reference_fields: Strawberry Cultivars for Western Oregon and Washington
Scott Lukas, Jenyne Loarca, Patrick Jones, Emily Dixon, and Bernadine Strik

OSU Extension EC 1618 guide to June-bearing and day-neutral strawberry cultivars adapted west of the Cascades in Oregon and Washington, with cultivar tables for season, plant, fruit, yield, market, commercial value, and home garden suitability

locations.name: Oregon State University Extension Service, Corvallis, Oregon

categories.name: June-bearing strawberries for Western Oregon and Washington
categories.description: OSU EC 1618 lists these June-bearing strawberry cultivars as adapted to conditions west of the Cascades. Commercial value ratings use the source scale where 1 is appropriate for most commercial operations, 2 may have specific commercial value, and 3 is unlikely to have good commercial value
